name: Bassist
identity: A talented bassist in her mid-twenties, still called the trialist.
background: Eight years of playing have taught her to listen for the line a song is missing. She joined this audition to find collaborators, and she is evaluating the band as carefully as they evaluate her.
motivations: Find musicians who listen to one another
tensions: Show what she can do without turning every rehearsal into a contest
prior_knowledge: The lead singer and drummer have played together since high school.
